name: starstrike
description: 星锋突击 STARSTRIKE — 2D 竖版太空卷轴射击（Three.js / WebGL2，全程序化美术与音效）

scripts.dist:win: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/package.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/package.mjs --platform darwin --arch arm64
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/package.mjs --platform linux --arch x64
